semantically_equivalent_models.justification: The model 'graph isomorphism network' is semantically equivalent to 'graph isomorphism networks'. This suggests a similar equivalence, as 'networks' can often denote the plural form or a broader range of instances of a singular 'network' model. Such equivalences are common in deep learning nomenclature where singular and plural forms refer to the same conceptual framework.

The model 'graph convolutional network' is semantically equivalent to 'graph convolutional networks'. Similar to the equivalence observed in other related terminologies, the singular 'network' and its plural 'networks' refer to the same type of deep learning model, just differing in number or scope.
